sketches.mechanism: Optional chaining — accessing a property through a chain of optionals returns nil and silently stops if any link is nil, never reaching the final value
sketches.resonance: The path to belonging exists syntactically but dissolves at the first absence, and the language treats this quiet failure as normal.

sketches.mechanism: The 'object' keyword creates a singleton — exactly one instance can ever exist, enforced by the language runtime
sketches.resonance: Loneliness expressed not as a feeling but as a structural guarantee: the type system ensures there will never be another.

sketches.mechanism: A LEFT JOIN preserves every row from the left table even when no match exists on the right, filling unmatched columns with NULL
sketches.resonance: Everyone is included in the result, but some sit at the table with nothing beside them — presence without connection.
sketches.draft:
SELECT everyone.name, belonging.place
FROM everyone
LEFT JOIN belonging
ON everyone.id = belonging.person_id
